title: The exterior product over a base of dimension one is associative
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)

difficulty_reason: With (S, delta) as in the situation of this section, X smooth over S and Y, Z, W locally of finite type over X, the lemma asserts that the product defined above on Chow groups satisfies (alpha . beta) . gamma = alpha . (beta . gamma) in CH_*(Y x_X Z x_X W) (statement lines 14917-14925). The proof starts from the associativity of the exterior product over S, (alpha x beta) x gamma = alpha x (beta x gamma) in CH_*(Y x_S Z x_S W), which is Lemma labelled lemma-exterior-product-associative-dim-1 (proof lines 14927-14929), and then introduces the closed immersions Delta_12, Delta_23 : X x_S X -> X x_S X x_S X, with bivariant classes Delta_12^! and Delta_23^! that are the restrictions of Delta^! along pr_12 and pr_23 (proof lines 14931-14948). The observation that restricting Delta_12^! along Delta_23 and Delta_23^! along Delta_12 both give Delta^! is converted by Lemma labelled lemma-gysin-commutes into Delta^! o Delta_12^! = Delta^! o Delta_23^! (proof lines 14950-14957). The lemma itself is then a six term chain of equalities expanding (alpha . beta) . gamma through Delta^!, replacing Delta^! by Delta_12^! and Delta_23^! using the commutation relation, and pulling Delta^! past the exterior factors using Remark labelled remark-commuting-exterior (proof lines 14959-14976). Controlling the two restriction equalities for the diagonal classes and using them to swap the order of the two Delta^! operations is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
